description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kudamaduwa, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520023
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership determinations for specific parcels of land (Parcel Nos. 86, 87, 89, and 65), including owner names, land extents, property details, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land property registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
